notes: 04: url/title/description/tags editable but no separate markdown 'note' field. 06: saveItem always creates a new item for a new URL (Date.now() id); no duplicate-url detection converging to edit. 10: tags entered as plain comma text, no autocomplete of existing tags. 11: card tags are non-clickable spans; filtering is by collection/favorites/read-later only, no tag filter. 12: search haystack covers title/description/domain/tags but not the full url path and there is no note field. 14: no #tag syntax handling. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses; plain substring match. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 20: no multi-select/checkboxes or bulk actions. 21: no bulk action over filtered collection. 23: description is plain text, not markdown, and not rendered as markdown; no note. 24: no page snapshot (metadata middleware only extracts meta tags); no PDF handling. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 26-28: no archive feature (Archive icon imported but unused); no archived list. 29: 'collections' are manual folders, not saved search-term+included/excluded-tag bundles. 30: no import. 31: exportLibrary downloads JSON, not Netscape HTML format. 32: no personal settings (default sort/displayed items/font size); the 'settings' button triggers export; view/sort are transient UI only.
